item.title: Hiroshima Sightseeing Guide: Peace Memorial, Miyajima & Hiroshima Castle
item.description: Hiroshima is one of those rare cities where the sightseeing list is short, the depth is enormous, and the contrast between sites is dramatic. The Peace Memorial Park and the Atomic Bomb Dome ask you to slow down and confront one of the twentieth century’s most consequential moments. An hour later, a ferry deposits you at Miyajima, where a vermillion torii gate stands in the sea and wild deer wander between thousand-year-old shrine pavilions.
